_doc: Fox Client cosmetics manifest. To add a cape: drop a 2:1 landscape PNG (64x32 or any HD multiple like 256x128) into assets/kitsune/textures/cape/<id>.png and register under 'capes'. To grant ownership: list cape ids under 'owners' keyed by the player's Minecraft UUID (with or without dashes). The '*' key grants to every player.
